incidents.body: We've found the cause. Emails to Microsoft-hosted mailboxes (Outlook.com, Hotmail, Microsoft 365) are being rate limited on the receiving side, and other email senders are seeing the same thing today. Emails are still accepted but some are delayed by several minutes while they're retried. Emails to all other providers are delivering normally. We're monitoring and will update when delivery times return to normal. If a code hasn't arrived, requesting a new one is the fastest workaround.

incidents.body: Between 21:21 and 21:56 UTC on June 9, 2026, a portion of requests to our Analytics service failed and Dashboard charts may have failed to load. The cause was a database connection that had been silently closed upstream but was still being reused by our connection pool. We resolved the issue at 21:56 UTC. No data was lost. To prevent recurrence, we are rolling out a change to detect and self-heal from such failures. We apologize for the disruption
